note: Labelled pilot conversations. Categories follow the client's convention, in which a routine password reset is technical and a lockout is account. Labels are the client's ground truth, not the classifier's output.

cases.subject: Reset my password
cases.body: I forgot my password and need a reset link so I can sign in again.

cases.subject: Setting up 2fa
cases.body: How do I set up the authenticator app for 2fa on my account?

cases.subject: Cancel my subscription
cases.body: How do I cancel my subscription before the next renewal date?

cases.subject: Need a receipt
cases.body: Where can I download the receipt for my invoice from last month?

cases.subject: Change display name
cases.body: I want to change the display name shown on my profile settings.

cases.subject: Locked out of my account
cases.body: I am locked out of my account and cannot get in at all.

cases.subject: Someone accessed my account
cases.body: Someone logged into my account without my permission last night.

cases.subject: Charged twice
cases.body: I was charged twice for my subscription this month.

cases.subject: Refund or I take this further
cases.body: I want a refund and I will take legal action if I do not get one.
